test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some C are P.

No C is a T.

All P are S.

**Conclusions :**

I. All S being C is a possibility.

II. At least some T are not C.

III. Some P are not T's.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
From the statements, the Venn diagram is:

Some C are P.

No C is a T.

All P are S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3289932017d92efbe1aedde0496c687ed5849f6ec5ebf676644baefe8048fd3a.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:

I. All S being C is a possibility → Follow [ As some C are P then there is a possibility that all S are C to be true and therefore the conclusion follows.] 

II. At least some T are not C → Follow [As no C is a T, So, itis definitely true some T are not C]

III. Some P are not T's** **→ Follow →[The common part of C and P will not T, So it is definitely true.]

So all the conclusions follow.

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
